heroHeadline: Parti Québécois Wins Minority Government in Quebec, Referendum Delayed Until After 2029
heroSubtitle: The PQ won about 59 of 127 seats on under 30% of the vote, short of a majority. Leader Paul St-Pierre Plamondon promises an independence referendum only after Donald Trump leaves office, while the Liberals and Conservatives vow to block one.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major news outlets, and institutional analyses.
